title: Director, Train Systems Operations - New York
text:
**Summary:** The Director, Train System Ops- NY is a leadership role responsible for overseeing structural planning 
for train operations and will determine planning initiatives to support strategic goals. The incumbent will 
conduct analysis of methods to improve operational objectives and enhance procedures to deliver more 
effective outcomes. This position is responsible for developing and implementing strategies to optimize 
system performance in partnership with Amtrak management to improve operational efficiency. It will also 
collaborate with other departments and stakeholders to align system operations with business objectives 
and drive continuous improvement initiatives across NJTRO. The Director, Train System Ops- NY 
requires a strong technical foundation, excellent leadership abilities, and the critical skill of effectively 
managing and prioritizing resources.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Act as liaison with Amtrak regarding emergency decisions and ensure quality assurance

measures are being implemented to benefit NJ TRANSIT Rail Operations.

* Analyzes problems, identifying alternative solutions, projecting consequences of proposed actions

in partnership with Amtrak management to minimize the impact to NJ TRANSITs on time 
performance.

* Perform a variety of routine and complex administrative, supervisory, and professional

responsibilities in providing customer focused, real -time public messaging for emergency and 
non-emergency events in coordination with Amtrak.

* Develop and implement long-term and short-term strategic plans for NJ TRANSIT systems,

aligning with the NJ TRANSIT’s Rail Operation’s goals. 

* Prepare and present reports on the on-time performance of the Northeast Corridor (NEC) and NY

Pennsylvania Station operations.

* Coordinate and attend weekly and monthly meetings with Amtrak management to ensure that

track outages do not impact NJT passenger service and ensure NJT services are protected 
during service disruptions on Amtrak territory.

**This Position Supervises:**

* New York (NY) Public Address Announcer
* Senior Manager, Train Operations
* Supervisor, Train Operations

**Education, Experience and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree (equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of formal

education) 

* Ten (10) years progressive managerial experience in rail operations with emphasis on train

movements, traffic control, dispatching, rail operating management of high-density railroad control 
systems.

**Knowledge and Skills:**

* Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance manuals,

technical and procedure manuals, ordinances and policies, laws, rules and regulations. 

* Ability to prepare reports and correspondence, maintain record and complete forms.
* Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with public safety officials,
* employees, supervisors, and the public.

**Working Environment:**

* Office and/or field

**At NJ Transit you will enjoy a competitive salary and excellent benefits package:**

* Comprehensive Family Health Insurance – Medical, Prescription, Dental, Vision
* Flexible Spending Account
* Life Insurance
* Paid Leave
* Tuition Assistance
* Pre-Tax Commuter Benefits Plan
* Retirement Plans:

 + 401(a) - Retirement plan with a 6% employer contribution
 + 401(k) - Retirement saving plan with up to an 3% company match
 + 457(b) - Deferred Savings Plan

**NJ TRANSIT is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
